newsitem.title: UKRAINE: FORECAST-Ukraine January inflation may rise to 2.5.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ukraine January inflation may rise to 2.5.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation could be as much as 2.5 percent in January after 0.9 percent in December 1996, Deputy Prime Minister Viktor Pynzenyk said.

"According to previous data for the first January's 10 days consumers prices were rising from last month level and we expect the monthly inflation rate in January may rose to 2.5 percent," Pynzenyk told reporters at the weekend.
He said the inflation rate was affected by consumer fever during January's holidays.
Economy Minister Vasyl Hureyev had earlier forecast the January inflation rate at under one percent.
Ukraine's draft budget foresees 1997 annual inflation of 25 percent compared to 39.7 percent in 1996 and 181.7 percent in 1995.
